I need to get in contact.

Right.

Office in Santa Monica.

I would say 50% of our clients have been with us since the either the very beginning or like year two.

Basically the people who are getting the 50 to $200 million checks mostly from Andreessen, come towards us.

But I also have a token bonus.
So, you know, it depends on how much crypto goes up.
So there is, you know, our base level but also with the potential to make real money from our token allocations which are vested for the length of our contract.
I love what I do.

Yeah, sorry, I just got to throw everything at.

So if you have any questions related.

Did you do it yourself?

Go.

It's beautiful.
Thank you.

Yeah.

Yeah.

Tiff and Jonathan.

Yeah.

I would say things like biz dev.

So.

And you got to take that with a pinch of salt.

I mean everything else looks brilliant.

Yeah.

So yeah, that's.

So.

And I'm not suggesting just fill that margin up with.
Oh no, no, no, no.

Okay.

Perfect.

All right.

summary.overview: During the Business Advisory Meeting, Kalie Moore, who operates a successful niche boutique agency in Berlin with a revenue of $1.1 million in 2023 and a consistent 10-20% year-over-year growth since 2020, discussed her agency's performance and client portfolio, which includes notable companies in gaming and Web3. Seeking guidance for an exit strategy within 2-5 years, Kalie was advised by Andy Day to establish layers of management to reduce her reliance on direct client relationships, thereby creating a business that can function independently. Recommendations included enhancing company visibility, considering a U.S. incorporation for tax advantages, and implementing a restructuring plan. Specific action items were identified, such as setting up a Nevada LLC, hiring additional personnel, and developing standard operating procedures. Andy offered coaching support to maximize business value, with plans for a follow-up meeting in July 2024 to assess progress.
summary.short_summary: Kalie Moore, who runs a successful niche boutique agency in Berlin with a revenue of $1.1 million in 2023 and a consistent 10-20% growth since 2020, discussed her agency's performance and client portfolio during the Business Advisory Meeting. Her agency specializes in gaming and Web3, servicing notable companies and maintaining a 50% client retention rate. Seeking guidance for an exit strategy within 2-5 years, Kalie received advice from Andy Day to establish layers of management to lessen her direct client dependency, thereby aiming to create a more autonomous business. Recommendations included enhancing company visibility, considering U.S. incorporation for tax benefits, and implementing a restructuring plan. Action items such as setting up a Nevada LLC, hiring new personnel, and developing operational procedures were identified, alongside Andy's offer for coaching support to maximize business value, with a follow-up scheduled for July 2024.
